verdict.rationale: Calendly's own Workflows feature automates pre- and post-meeting emails and texts around scheduled events, and routing forms apply rule logic to screen and route people before they book. The documented action types are limited to communications and routing, and the docs don't show configurable trigger conditions. Webhook subscriptions are a developer building block for external automations, so they add no direct credit here. Missing for 10: documented rule configuration (triggers, conditions, timing), a broader set of actions beyond emails/texts and routing, and independent hands-on corroboration of Workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use Workflows to automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates.
Create a routing form that uses basic routing logic (fixed answer responses) to screen and qualify people before they book with you.
Automatically look up and match known leads to assigned account owners from Salesforce and HubSpot.
